# Suppression policy

Suppression is a proposal, not an automatic write.

Every proposed suppression must include:

- an existing work-item key;
- a reason;
- the matching signal field or fingerprint;
- an expiry or review date;
- evidence that the signal is understood;
- version and trend evidence when claiming the issue is fixed or expected.

Never edit the repository suppression YAML from triage without explicit
approval. If approval is granted, show the exact proposed diff before applying
it.
